phases.objective: Reconcile the already-integrated parallel governance workstreams and the bounded staging OAuth, Frontend dispatch, and Act-as-User runtime changes in one standard PR without enabling provider dispatch, live mutation, SQL Apply, Production promotion, or secret transport.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Standard pull request head evaluation against main
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact PR head is evaluated against all affected integrated contracts, generated artifacts are deterministic, staging OAuth/OpenAPI and Act-as-User controls remain fail-closed, and no live or Production mutation is authorized.
steps: Resolve the exact PR head, base ref, affected runtime files, and integrated parallel contract set.
Verify every affected runtime file is covered by this single-PR scope and the owning integrated contracts.
Run deterministic Frontend generated-artifact, OpenAPI auth parity, staging governance, Act-as-User, and E2E contract checks.
Require shadow-only or read-only outcomes for write-capable paths and preserve secret exclusion, protected-ref, and promotion guards.
Persist the evaluation and inventory readbacks against the exact head before any owner attestation or merge decision.
assertions: The maintenance exception is valid only for base main, an implemented mvp, and fully integrated parallel workstreams.
All runtime files changed by this PR match the bounded maintenance scope and remain attributable to the integrated contracts.
Generated Frontend and repository governance artifacts are deterministic and show no uncommitted drift after generation.
Staging OAuth/OpenAPI parity, Act-as-User hierarchy, CAS/replay protection, mandatory readback, and lower-role same-tenant constraints remain enforced.
No secrets are included and no provider dispatch, live mutation, SQL Apply, Production promotion, or protected-ref mutation occurs.
